method: Assistant directly inspected all three accepted contact sheets (33 new sampled query-image pairs) and enlarged uncertain originals; also re-inspected all three previously reviewed red-bowl positives. Titles and media supplied supporting catalogue evidence. No labels inferred from model score; no human confirmation.
sampling: Frozen hash-ordered accepted sample, at most 12 previously unreviewed object groups per query; gourd has only 9 eligible groups, red has none. Existing reviewed groups excluded. Red 3 included separately as previously reviewed case rechecks. No rejected candidates sampled.
limitations: Accepted-only diagnostic; no estimate of full-gallery recall.
Small selected sample, AI-assisted labels, not independent human gold.
Prior-reviewed red cases include a fit image; never combine these into independent precision.
Black-and-white photos may support shape-only queries; they cannot establish requested colors.
No model fitting, thresholds or default changes after this audit.
